COMPLAINT CENTER - Public Safety & Ethical Reporting Center is Live Now.
Why this Reporting Center exists:-
The Fitness Standards & Safety Council of India (FSSC) maintains this reporting mechanism to support public safety, ethical awareness, and responsible fitness practices.
This platform allows individuals to confidentially submit concerns related to:
• Promotion or encouragement of illegal drug use
• Misrepresentation of fitness outcomes
• Advice beyond defined professional scope
• Unsafe practices that may harm individuals
